name: Tokeijikake no Ley Line -Zan'ei no Yoru ga Akeru Toki-
original_name: 時計仕掛けのレイライン －残影の夜が明ける時－
source:
Michiru and Ushio continue to spend their days solving problems at Tenbinruri Academy as part of the special investigation office, otherwise known as 'Tokusa'. One day, a foreign girl named Adelheid came to seek their help in looking for her grandmother's memento. Along the way, will they find out more about the link between the day and night worlds?

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/01/01/january-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
满和潮继续在天秤琉璃学园作为特别调查室——又称“十草”——的成员解决问题。一天，一位名叫阿黛尔海德的外国女孩前来寻求帮助，寻找她祖母的遗物。在这过程中，她们是否会发现更多关于日间世界和夜间世界之间联系的秘密？

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/01/01/january-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
